title: Is Multimodal Speculative Decoding Ready for Diffusion-Based Parallel Drafting? A Survey and Empirical Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2608.20743v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by allowing a lightweight drafter to propose future tokens while a target model verifies them in parallel. Its lossless guarantee has motivated a line of work that pushes the drafter itself toward parallel generation. The most recent paradigm is block-parallel generative drafting, including diffusion-based methods such as DFlash and DSpark, achieving up to 3.6x speedup on common daily chatting tasks. While this transition is well studied in text-only LLMs, its applicability to multimodal models remains an open question. Existing multimodal speculative decoding efforts focus on input compression, adapter alignment, candidate coverage, or modality-specific verification; however, block-parallel generative drafting remains largely unexplored. translated_title: 多模态推测解码是否已准备好用于基于扩散的并行草拟？一项综述与实证诊断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20743v1 公告类型：新 摘要：推测解码通过允许轻量级草拟器提出未来令牌，同时目标模型并行验证它们，从而加速自回归生成。其无损保证推动了一系列工作，使草拟器本身趋向于并行生成。最新的范式是块并行生成式草拟，包括基于扩散的方法如DFlash和DSpark，在常见日常聊天任务上实现了高达3.6倍的加速。虽然这种转变在纯文本大型语言模型中已得到充分研究，但其对多模态模型的适用性仍是一个开放问题。现有的多模态推测解码工作侧重于输入压缩、适配器对齐、候选覆盖或模态特定验证；然而，块并行生成式草拟在很大程度上仍未探索。为弥合这一差距，本文结合以模态为中心的综述和跨架构的实证研究，提出一个问题：多模态推测解码是否已准备好用于并行草拟？
tldr: 本文通过综述和实证诊断，首次系统探讨了多模态推测解码中基于扩散的块并行草拟范式的可行性，并指出其在当前多模态模型中的未充分探索状态。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically investigates the feasibility of diffusion-based block-parallel drafting in multimodal speculative decoding through a survey and empirical diagnosis, highlighting its underexplored status in current multimodal models.
